summary: Coupon codes at checkout: one real problem, one test gap.

risk.rationale: Changes how checkout totals are computed; tests cover the happy path only.

tour.title: Tests for the coupon rules
tour.summary: The rounding and no-coupon cases are covered.

tour.title: Pricing helper
tour.summary: Applies a percentage coupon to line items. Check rounding and the negative total.

tour.title: Checkout API endpoint
tour.summary: Uses the helper and returns 422 on a bad code. Check where prices come from.

findings.title: Total can go negative
findings.body: A discount above the subtotal is not capped.
findings.comment: A coupon larger than the subtotal gives a negative total. Clamp at 0 and add a test.

findings.title: Client prices are trusted
findings.body: The subtotal is computed from items in the request body.
findings.comment: Prices come from the request, so a client can set its own. Look them up server side.

overview.before: A coupon code was ignored at checkout, so every order paid the full price.
overview.after: Checkout applies a percentage coupon to the items, and an invalid code is refused with a clear error.
